description: Draft v4 revision of the universal tenant input standard. NOT the approved standard -- v3 (universal-tenant-input-standard-2026-07-v3) remains the only approved tenant input/template standard until this is explicitly reviewed and the registry's legacySourcePurge.allowedSourceOfTruth and policy.universalTemplateStandardV3IsOnlyApprovedStandard are updated to admit it. Versioned per standing instruction rather than silently redefining v3's meaning.
changeFromV3: 13_evidence_sources.csv is redefined as a pure source-artifact registry: one row per LOGICAL SOURCE ARTIFACT VERSION, with both a stable source_id (the logical source) and a required source_version_id (this snapshot). A new 19_executive_interviews.csv domain carries structured interview observations linked to source_version_id. A new 20_evidence_items.csv domain is a citation/observation ledger (one row per fact, excerpt, or interview signal extracted from a source), linked to evidence_sources via the REQUIRED source_version_id foreign key -- not source_id -- so history isn't overwritten when the same logical source reappears in a later snapshot. Domains 00-12 and 14-18 are carried forward from v3 unchanged -- see datasets/tenant-inputs/templates/universal/standard-2026-07-v3/template-manifest.json for their column definitions, which this draft does not duplicate to avoid drift between two copies of unchanged content.

templates.entityMeaning: One row per LOGICAL SOURCE ARTIFACT VERSION -- a CSV/workbook, contract document, interview transcript, workshop output, system export, API snapshot, benchmark report, etc, as it existed at a given snapshot/version. NOT one row per citation or observation -- see 20_evidence_items.csv for that. The same logical source can legitimately have multiple version rows over time without overwriting history.
templates.notes: source_ref replaces v3's source_file -- an artifact is not always literally a file. The consolidation process must preserve source_ref as this row's semantic business identity; it must NEVER be overwritten with the physical path of the file being consolidated (that belongs in a separate lineage column, original_source_file, outside this template). source_kind (v3's source_type) is intentionally excluded from identity entirely -- multiple distinct artifacts, or multiple versions of one artifact, can share a kind. source_id example: SRC-SHA-EXEC-INTERVIEWS. source_version_id example: SRCV-SHA-EXEC-INTERVIEWS-20260725.

templates.entityMeaning: One row per structured interview observation (one question/answer from one stakeholder), linked to the source version representing the transcript, workbook, or interview export it came from.
templates.notes: A tenant with no interview evidence has an empty canonical 19_executive_interviews.csv and an honest not_assessed result downstream for Leadership Agenda / Interview Signals -- never generic operating-model prose masquerading as interview findings. One interview source snapshot produces many interview rows, which in turn each produce one or more 20_evidence_items.csv rows with row-level locators.

templates.entityMeaning: One row per individual citeable evidence unit -- a fact, excerpt, interview signal, metric, or observation extracted FROM a source version. Many evidence_items reference one evidence_source version.
templates.notes: Foreign key is source_version_id, not source_id -- linking to a specific snapshot rather than the logical source keeps evidence provenance stable even when the same logical source is re-ingested later as a new version.
